entities.name: Arixmethes
entities.description: A massive kraken of Theros, so large it is mistaken for an island, with a city built upon its back.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god of Theros who, in obscure legends, smote the coastal city Arixmethes.

entities.name: Khrusor
entities.description: The weapon Heliod used to smite the coastal city Arixmethes.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who battled the sea god Thassa while Arixmethes awakened.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god of Theros, fought by Kiora.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in whose course Arixmethes fought in defense of Theros.

events.summary: Obscure legends say Heliod smote the coastal polis Arixmethes with Khrusor and cast it into the sea.
events.quote: Heliod smote this coastal city with Khrusor and cast it into the sea

events.summary: Arixmethes awakened while Kiora battled Thassa and wrought great destruction on the city on his back.
events.quote: When he awakened, as the planeswalker Kiora battled the sea god Thassa

events.summary: Arixmethes fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Arixmethes fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: Arixmethes is a kraken from Theros.
relations.quote: Arixmethes is a kraken from Theros
